description:
Who holds a licence to trade at or around an address: food and drink, childcare and clinics, and more. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "Is the restaurant at this address licensed?"
- "How many licensed childcare providers within a mile of 1500 Rice St?"

address.description: A street address in the seven-county Minneapolis-St. Paul metro, city after a comma. Omit for the market-wide count.

cut.description: all: every licensed business; food: food, drink and groceries; care: childcare, care homes and clinics; mpca: on a parcel the state holds a file on. Default all.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: business_licenses_nearby
title: Business Licenses Nearby
